clusters.pick_reason: PR #1948 applies the fix at the Server base class level by guarding all three send*ListChanged() methods against the capability flag, making it impossible to send a notification when listChanged is false regardless of how capabilities are set. PR #1937 fixes the issue only in the McpServer registration path (mcp.ts), leaving the send methods themselves unguarded. #1948's approach is more complete and also includes the changeset-equivalent protection at the infrastructure layer.
